name: Change Proceed To Checkout Text
author: Irish_Cathal

sections.description:
Change Proceed To Checkout Text provides a simple settings screen for changing the WooCommerce cart checkout button text without code.

The core Proceed to Checkout text feature remains free and supports both classic WooCommerce carts and the modern Cart Block.

Advanced functionality lets licensed customers customise additional WooCommerce labels including Add to Cart, Place Order, View Cart, Update Cart, Apply Coupon, Return to Shop and Select Options. It also adds a custom checkout destination and conditional Proceed to Checkout rules based on product, product category or minimum cart total, cart quantity, product type, login status, customer role, chosen shipping method or chosen payment method. Product and category rules use searchable WooCommerce selectors, so store owners do not need to look up numeric IDs. Advanced settings are retained if a licence is deactivated; only their execution is disabled.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings > Checkout Button Text.
  3. Enter your preferred Proceed to Checkout text and save.
  4. Advanced customers can purchase the upgrade at https://arrowdesign.ie/product/change-proceed-to-checkout-text-advanced/ and enter their licence key on the same settings page.

  • Improved upgrade calls-to-action so Free users are taken directly to the Advanced product page.
  • Audited Free / Advanced gating and retained the original Proceed to Checkout control as permanently free functionality.
  • Retained Advanced settings when a licence is inactive or deactivated.
  • Removed a duplicate Settings link from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  • Tidied licence/settings state handling and release metadata.
  • Preserved weekly licence validation and the seven-day offline communication grace period.

3.8.0

  • Improved the Free / Advanced commercial experience throughout the settings screen.
  • Added a clear Advanced feature summary for Free users.
  • Added Advanced links on the WordPress Plugins screen and settings page.
  • Added clearer Free and Advanced licence status panels.
  • Added masked licence-key display for active licences.
  • Added last verified and next automatic licence-check information.
  • Added licence expiry display when supplied by the licence server.
  • Added safer licence deactivation confirmation.
  • Preserved all Free functionality, Advanced features, rules and existing licence data.

3.7.0

  • Added Advanced minimum cart quantity rules.
  • Added product-type rules, including subscription product types when available.
  • Added logged-in/guest rules and customer-role rules.
  • Added chosen shipping-method and payment-method rules.
  • Preserved existing rules, Free functionality, Advanced settings and licence data.

3.6.0

  • Replaced raw Product ID rule entry with a searchable WooCommerce product selector.
  • Replaced raw Category ID rule entry with a searchable WooCommerce product-category selector.
  • Added a purpose-built amount field for minimum cart-total rules.
  • Existing 3.5.0 rules are migrated transparently and continue to work.
  • Improved the conditional-rule interface and dynamically initialised selectors for newly added rules.
  • Preserved all Free functionality, Advanced settings and licence data.

3.5.0

  • Added an Advanced custom Proceed to Checkout destination URL.
  • Added conditional Proceed to Checkout rules.
  • Rules can match a product ID, product category ID or minimum cart total.
  • Matching rules can override the checkout button text and destination URL.
  • Rules are evaluated in order; the first enabled matching rule is used.
  • Added WooCommerce Cart Block support for the custom checkout destination.
  • Preserved all Free functionality, Advanced settings and licence data.

3.4.0

  • Added Advanced View Cart text control.
  • Added Advanced Update Cart text control.
  • Added Advanced Apply Coupon text control.
  • Added Advanced Return to Shop text control.
  • Added separate Advanced Select Options text control for variable products.
  • Preserved all Free functionality and existing Advanced licence/settings data.

3.3.0

  • Added single-plugin Free / Advanced architecture.
  • Added Arrow Design licence activation, deactivation and validation.
  • Added weekly licence validation with a seven-day offline communication grace period.
  • Added licensed Add to Cart text control for classic WooCommerce product buttons.
  • Added licensed Place Order text control for classic checkout and the WooCommerce Checkout Block.
  • Added Free / Advanced status and locked Advanced controls to the settings screen.
  • Advanced settings are preserved when a licence becomes inactive.

3.2.0

  • Added support for the WooCommerce Cart Block Proceed to Checkout button.
  • Retained full support for the classic WooCommerce cart/shortcode.
  • Declared WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks compatibility.
  • Tested with WordPress 7.0 and WooCommerce 10.9.

3.1.0

  • Updated and tested for WordPress 7.0.
  • Updated plugin metadata and WordPress.org readme fields.
  • Removed invalid Contributors metadata.
  • Modernised settings and security.
